notes:
• Titles that say who wrote to whom: detected letter titles now read “Letter from Dr. Anna Weber, Nordwind Energy GmbH to Ministry of Energy re Delay of the works” — sender from the signature block or letterhead, addressee from the address block or salutation, the subject only appended. Names from the matter’s People list are preferred; German and French matters use “Schreiben von … an …” / “Lettre de … à …”. Works on import and via Exhibit ▸ Read Subject & Date; Settings ▸ General can switch back to subject-only.
• Rename in place: Return, F2 or ⌘R on a selected exhibit edits its title right in the list. Tab commits and jumps to the next exhibit, Shift-Tab to the previous, Esc cancels — a fresh import can be titled straight down the list without touching the mouse.
• Exhibit ▸ Find & Replace in Titles… (⌥⌘R): replace a pattern across all selected exhibits at once, with “match case” and “regular expression” options. Organized storage renames the files accordingly.
